versions.body:
People who use the address, in their own words.

“Mail arrives, we look established, and I have not watered a plant in two years.”
— D. Chen, Haven Mutual

A picture of one of the people we looked after this year is below. He has the sort of face clients already trust.

18 Harbor Street is a virtual address. The names on the board in the lobby are real firms. They collect their mail here. They are not all the same company.

Suite 110 — Quay Ledger, bookkeeping. quayledger.com
Suite 120 — Amber Fern Tutoring. No website yet; they still send a paper flyer.
Suite 210 — North Lamp Studio, signs and type. northlamp.studio
Suite 305 — Gull Wing Surveys, marine surveys. They answer the phone.

Rooms, when you need a room, are on Dock Road.
